description: Data for: Railway and road infrastructure in the Belt and Road Initiative countries: Estimating the impact of transport infrastructure on economic growth is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Chao Wang. The study area includes 65 BRI countries. However, due to limited data availability, only 64 countries were used to analyze the economic growth (PCGDP), 62 countries were used to analyze the rail infrastructure (RAIL), and 49 countries were used to analyze the road infrastructure (ROAD) in the analysis of the spatial-temporal characteristics and spatial autocorrelation. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
